reaction: A straightforward result, with no particular surprise.

reason: Fit the cover to the potato trough to keep light off developing tubers; it is the only combination offered.
expectation: The tubers will be shaded and the remaining goal completed.

effect: The cover completed the lightproof trough and the chapter's remaining goal.
reaction: It is satisfying to finish the growing setup, though I wanted more detail about how the cover accommodates the plants.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the cover gave the potato setup a clear practical purpose: keeping light off developing tubers.

leastWorthwhile.text: Planting the potatoes gave only a creation label, so it felt rather mechanical.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the materials became the cover I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the cover's construction and how shoots emerge were left unclear.

continue.text: I would probably continue for the field trip and the larger story, although this short planting sequence itself offered little discovery or decision-making.
